text:
evelyn: Starting 02:00 UTC change window. Scope: flip router header split (x-rd-routing) + enable runtime kernel_batched=true in eu-opt cluster. Need API pinned to v2.16.0-canary before header flip. Canary plan: 5% for 7m -> 40% for 13m -> 100%.

harry: ack. Console PR ready with rollback snippet and screenshots: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pull/4421

sara: api pinned to v2.16.0-canary in prod registry, checksum verified.

deploybot: created wave wave-836512-A for services: api, router, runtime, console. Canary set to 5% for 7m.

evelyn: preflight checklist: api pin ✅, runtime image pushed ✅, console note ✅, router flag staged ✅, dashboard live ✅, rollback runbook attached.

metrics-bot: dashboard: https://obs.redwood/dash/983 - tracking x-rd-routing ratio, api 5xx, runtime restarts. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

harry: runtime image rolling to canary pool now. Smoke in staging: p95 -6ms, cpu +4% in canary nodes.

deploybot: runtime rollout started (job id rb-836512-rt). Canary nodes: 9.

harry: flipping router header to split-v2 on 5% canary. Quick curl health check passes.

metrics-bot: early metrics t+2m: api 5xx = 0.03% (baseline 0.03%), p95 +7ms. No alerts.

evelyn: rollback trigger: api 5xx >0.5% sustained 3m OR p95 >30% increase OR >3 pod restarts in 10m.

harry: saw one runtime pod restart on shard-4 at t+5m, restarted cleanly. Increased heap headroom for that shard in canary.

deploybot: progressing to 40% (wave wave-836512-A). Noted transient 502s during router reconnection but recovered.

metrics-bot: aggregated t+18m: p95 +12ms, api 5xx 0.04%. Trend stable.

sara: publishing release note: "Router: gradual header-split rollout (x-rd-routing). Runtime: kernel batching opt-in enabled." Notifying Support/SRE.

evelyn: proceeding to 100% after 5m stable. If anything appears, tag #eng-oncall and follow the runbook.

deploybot: rollout to 100% completed for api/router/runtime/console. wave-836512-A closed.

metrics-bot: post-rollout summary t+40m: api 5xx 0.05%, p95 +9ms, runtime restarts normalized. No incidents.

sara: sent digest to support and SRE with runbook and dashboard links.

evelyn: thanks team, closing window.
